notes.title: The Endless Cruise
notes.content:
Update 3.0 is here!And there's a new content for endgame!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/25f85eb8157013b4143becbc81536a0fa98f1820.png"]
Introducing our NEW Game Mode: EndlessSee how long your builds will last!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/05f64605ca9ec8a4aa2978e0a5869c4f61cbe9af.png"]


Use Relics you've discovered from the Reliquary.And use Abilities you've unlocked from Survival.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/8115b21ce268b0c38c968d690a5af6e01eded5f8.png"]


Compete! Score as many kills as you canfrom a never-ending wave of evolving enemies!

[previewyoutube="L_vyNpFKd98;full"][/previewyoutube]



These Relics are balanced separately only for this mode:
- The White Knight:

  Checkmate damage bonus +16% -> +4%

- Lantern of the Dead:

  Stats gained from KO'd units +10 -> +2

- Debonair Crown:

  No limit on effect gained per level -> Max 20 levels

- Eye of the Storm:

  No limit on stacks gained -> Max 18 stacks

- Seraphim Necklace:

  +1 AGI per level -> per 4 levels


Miscellaneous Changes:
- Starting on a new save will now ask you what game mode piques your interest.

- All Zodiacs in survival mode no longer needs to be unlocked.

- The Surrender option no longer needs to be unlocked.

- For new players (new save file), Leaderboard is now unlocked the same time Endless Mode is unlocked.

- Updated the definition of Fortune in the stats menu.


Balance Changes:
- Basic Attack: restore 30% mana

  -> restore 70% of missing mana if below 30% mana

- Dio's default title: max MP per level

  buffed from 10 to 20.

- Rin's default title: max MP per level

  buffed from 10 to 20.

- Jirah's default title: max MP per level

  nerfed from 15 to 5.

- Selene's default title: MAT per level

  nerfed from 3 to 2.

- Hydro Blast splash damage bonus:

  now has a limit of +200%.

- Coil Ring bonus Electric damage

  to units without Electric Discharge: +25% -> +18%


Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Equip menu sometimes becoming accessible while in survival mode.

notes.title: Update 2.0 now available
notes.content:
Our BIG Free Update is here!
And there's a brand NEW way to play the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/84f8cf94cdb2c75b0926a86fc8af1c8ac0231819.png

Introducing our NEW Game Mode: Survival
Fight endless hordes of enemies until the final boss, the Zodiac!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/a40f7bc6e1775a36ccb2141368c819ebc124fdfb.png

Select up to 4-star Difficulty.
Unlock ALL 162 Abilities from first win rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/41a1b3126aacab488e97739abcdd74fcac97db4f.png

Power up each time an enemy is killed with ARPG-like loot system.
Choose upgrades from augments, items, passives, special effects/events, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409532/f119ee46bf1934a4784c7d0a532b8ab6be6d07c8.png

There are also 5 NEW Hazards!

Radioactive Fallout
- At the end of each unit's turn,
  they'll receive 1 stack of Radiation Exposure.

Hellgate Opened
- The first time anyone deal or receive direct damage,
  the attack will apply 1 stack of Devil's Wrath.

Below the Surface
- Units above 50% health receive 5% more damage.
- Units below 50% health deal 5% more damage.

Memento Mori
- At the end of each unit's turn,
  if they have less than 10 harmful effects,
  they'll receive a random damaging Harmful Effect.

Divine Punishments
- At the end of each unit's turn,
  if they have less than 10 harmful effects,
  they'll receive a random non-damaging Harmful Effect.


Balance Changes:
- Crescent Moon Slash is now a dual element of Water and Light.
- Poison Needles is now a dual element of Wind and Water.
- Ball Lightning no longer interacts with Barrier.
- Ball Lightning Mana Cost lowered to 120.
- Juxtaposition now deals Magic Damage.
- Aurora Slash now deals Magic Damage.
- Analyzed now lasts for 5 turns.
- Heavenly Flamesword scaling damage buffed to (+4 per MAT).
- Hydro Blast scaling damage readjusted to (+1.8 per MAT)(+1.8 per LUK).
- Shatterfrost MAT scaling damage nerfed to (+3 per MAT).
- Healing Flames now also scale with LUK.
- Rift Slash's damage buffed to 700 (+5 per MAT).
- Unleashed Frenzy can now expire.
- Hail of Blades cooldown lowered to 2.
- Masterlock of Bones no longer grants Interlocking Bones on Physical Crits.
- Bellows Breath (stolen) damage buffed to 750 (+5 per MAT).
- Minibombs damage increased to 25 per stack.
- Golden Blight damage nerfed to 6 per stack.
- Razorleaves damage buffed to 475 (+2.25 per ATK)(+2.75 per MAT).
- Diamond Puncture damage scaling buffed to (+3.1 per ATK).
- Throw Snowball damage scaling buffed to (+2.8 per ATK)(+4 per MAT).
- Boulder Toss base damage buffed to 480.
- Gem Toss damage scaling buffed to 400%.
- Poison Spores damage scaling buffed to (+4.8 per MAT).
- Mana Lance damage buffed to 700 (+4 per MAT).
- Mana Lance max Lifesteal possible nerfed to 30%.
- Cold Cuts base damage buffed to 475.
- Summon Kelpie damage scaling buffed to (+2.8 per MAT).
- Starburst Frenzy damage scaling buffed to (+3.6 per MAT)(+2.4 per ATK).
- Death Arc damage scaling buffed to (+3.3 per ATK).
- Puff Out damage scaling nerfed to (+1.2 per MAT).
- Puff Out Mana Cost reduced to 80.
- Sakura Slash damage scaling buffed to (+4 per LUK).
- Windsweeps damage scaling nerfed to (+3 per AGI).
- Windsweeps cooldown increased to 4.
- The Big Leap damage buffed to 200 (+4 per ATK).
- Blade Dance damage scaling buffed to (+3.25 per ATK).
- Unlimited Blade now has base damage.
- Unlimited Blade scaling damage nerfed to +2 per stat.
- Divine Slash damage scaling buffed to (+5 per LUK).
- Flameweaving damage scaling buffed to (+5 per MAT).
- Underground Assault damage scaling buffed to (+3.75 per ATK).
- Winter Bloom damage scaling buffed to (+3 per MAT).
- Twin Blades base damage buffed to 600.
- Cross Stitch damage scaling buffed to (+2.77 per ATK).
- Spirit Lightning damage scaling buffed to (+5 per MAT).
- Oil Spill damage scaling buffed to (+2.8 per MAT).
- Rolling Fireballs base damage nerfed to 266.
- Ardent Strike damage scaling buffed to (+5 per LUK).
- Scars of Stars nerfed to 5%.
- Poison Clouds damage scaling nerfed to (+2.6 per MAT).
- Wind Stream damage scaling buffed to (+3 per AGI).
- Titanic Slash base damage nerfed to 70.
- Cold Wave base damage buffed to 600.
- Cold Wave now makes all enemies Cold regardless if it hits.
- Fortunate Strikes by your team now deals bonus damage equal to 3x LUK
  (enemies stay at 1x LUK).

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where previous score is being added to uploaded score.
- Fixed a bug where manual saving gets interrupted early.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes results in an error when opening Equips from a saved file.

v.2.01 micropatch:
- Fixed a rare instance where the game doesn't fully switch to Survival Mode.
- Fixed a bug where the first four enemies in Survival Mode are all Heavy Gunners.

v.2.02 micropatch:
- Adventure Mode is no longer locked for new saves.
- Reduced the difficulty of 1 star battles in Survival Mode.

v.2.03 micropatch:
- Desecrated, a non-damaging harmful effect, is now banned from the random pool.
- Replaced "Save then close the game" with "Save" only.
- Manual saving from the lobby is now available.
- Game now checks if save file is corrupted (happens when the game is closed while saving, please avoid doing this) and will try to fix the save file.
- Fixed a bug where retrying a lost battle against Taurus will result in battling Scorpio instead, and vice versa.

notes.title: v.1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v.1.03 Patch Notes:

 Land of Samurai (Location Hazard) now also makes everyone start with Death By a Thousand Cuts.
 Default Random Target Resistance of all Zodiacs are now 33%.
 All Random Target and Group Target abilities no longer require a double-click to confirm target.
 You can now click the character sprites for abilities that target allies.
 Quick Inspect now autoselects the last unit you've selected (if there's any and if they're not KO'd).
 Fixed a few music and sound effects that are ignoring the set volume level.
 Fixed an issue where some texts are not rendering properly on some devices.
 Updated messages that are still referencing the old mid-save feature.

notes.title: Patch v.1.02 (Easy Mode)
notes.content:
Easy Mode is here!
   - It's a new mode for players that are still learning the game.
   - Easy Mode has its own separate leaderboard.
   - New games now start on Easy Mode by default.
 Hard Mode now rewards 2x more Red Orbis.
 You can now see currently equipped gear when choosing for gear rewards.
 Manual Saving is no longer restricted!
   In the middle of an adventure? You can now save anytime before ending your session!
 Any ally can be clicked now if the target is 'All Allies' rather than just Dio.
